title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Establishment of Outlying Divisions of High Courts) An outlying division of the Gwangju High Court shall be established respectively at the locations of the Jeju District Court and Jeonju District Court; an outlying division of the Daejeon High Court at the location of the Cheongju District Court; outlying divisions of the Seoul High Court respectively at the locations of the Incheon District Court and Chuncheon District Court; and outlying divisions of the Busan High Court respectively at the locations of the Ulsan District Court and Changwon District Court. <Amended on June 28, 2018; June 1, 2020>
